content.text:
Here's a summary of each demo HTML file:

## 1. anijs.html
**Title:** AniJS demo
**Controls:** "Add Widget" button
**Grid Contents:** 1 initial widget, grows dynamically when adding new items with random sizes (1-3 units)
**Event Handlers:** 'added' event triggers swing animation via AniJS library; removes animations after completion

## 2. cell-height.html
**Title:** Cell Height grid options demo
**Controls:** Buttons for "auto", "initial", "100px", "10vh", "10%" cellHeight options; displays current setting
**Grid Contents:** 3 predefined items at various positions (0,0), (1,0), (3,0)
**Event Handlers:** Click handlers on buttons call setOpt() to change cellHeight dynamically; displays selected value

## 3. column.html
**Title:** Column grid demo (fix cellHeight)
**Controls:** Load buttons (list, case 1, random, Add Widget); column buttons (1-12 columns); re-layout dropdown (list, compact, move+scale, move, scale, none, custom); displays current column count
**Grid Contents:** Variable - either 16-item list or 7 test items with mixed dimensions; each widget has X removal button
**Event Handlers:** 'added removed change' events log item positions; column() changes grid layout; random() generates 8 widgets

## 4. css_attributes.html
**Title:** Demo showcasing how to use gridstack.js attributes in CSS
**Controls:** "Add Widget" button; uses external events.js for handlers
**Grid Contents:** Starts with 1 widget; can add more with random dimensions
**Interactions:** Uses CSS to display widget dimensions via data attributes; drag and resize enabled

## 5. float.html
**Title:** Float grid demo
**Controls:** "Add Widget", "Make Widget", "float: true/false" toggle button
**Grid Contents:** Starts with 5 items at various positions; can add more dynamically
**Event Handlers:** addNewWidget() adds via API; makeNewWidget() creates DOM element then converts to widget; toggleFloat() switches float mode and updates button text

## 6. grid-lines.html
**Title:** Grid Lines demo
**Controls:** Toggle checkbox (Show lines), color picker, opacity slider (0-100%), thickness slider (1-8px), columns slider (2-24 columns); displays current values in badges
**Grid Contents:** 9 fixed items (A-I) at predefined positions in 12-column grid
**Event Handlers:** Toggle adds/removes 'gs-show-grid-lines' class; sliders update CSS custom properties (--gs-line-color, --gs-line-thickness); columns slider calls grid.column()

## 7. knockout.html
**Title:** Knockout.js Demo
**Controls:** "Add Widget" button (Knockout data-bind)
**Grid Contents:** 4 initial widgets with predefined positions (0,0), (2,0), (6,0), (1,2); each has "Delete me" button
**Event Handlers:** addNewWidget() pushes to observable array; deleteWidget() removes from array via Knockout binding; afterAddWidget callback makes DOM elements into widgets

## 8. lazy_load.html
**Title:** Lazy loading + renderCB demo
**Controls:** None (demonstration page only)
**Grid Contents:** 6 items (numbered 0-5) in scrollable container (height: 300px) with 200px cell height
**Event Handlers:** renderCB renders heading and content for each widget; lazyLoad:true delays widget creation until visible (logged to console)

## 9. mobile.html
**Title:** Simple mobile demo
**Controls:** None (static demo)
**Grid Contents:** 3 widgets in 3-column layout: (0,0), (1,0 h:2), (2,0)
**Interactions:** Shows resize handles on mobile; supports native touch events (no explicit handlers in JS)

## 10. nested.html
**Title:** Nested grids demo
**Controls:** Add Widget, Add Widget Grid1, Add Widget Grid2, Add Nested Grid; static/editable radio buttons; Save, Destroy, Create, Save list, Save no content, Clear, Load buttons
**Grid Contents:** 1 parent grid with 3 items, including 2 nested sub-grids (sub1 with 6 items, sub2 with 2 items)
**Event Handlers:** addEvents() logs drag/drop/resize; setStatic() toggles editable mode; save/destroy/load manage full or partial grid state; GridStack.setupDragIn() enables sidebar drag into grids

## 11. nested_advanced.html
**Title:** Advanced Nested grids demo
**Controls:** Add Widget, Add W Grid0/1/2 buttons; Save Full, Destroy, Re-create, Save layout, Clear, Load buttons; textarea output
**Grid Contents:** 1 parent grid with 3 items, 2 nested sub-grids with 1-2 items each
**Event Handlers:** subGridDynamic:true creates sub-grids on the fly (drag item over another); save()/destroy()/load() manage full/partial state; displays JSON output in textarea

## 12. nested_constraint.html
**Title:** Constraint Nested grids demo
**Controls:** Add Widget, Add Widget Grid1, Add Widget Grid2 buttons; Save, Destroy, Create, Save list, Save no content, Clear, Load buttons
**Grid Contents:** 1 parent grid with 3 items, 2 nested sub-grids (sub1 with 6 pink items, sub2 with 2 pink items)
**Event Handlers:** acceptWidgets constraint restricts sub-grids to accept only '.grid-stack-item.sub' class items; save/destroy/load manage state
